blocks.text: Jab helper T cell fa'al hota hai to woh sirf cell-mediated immunity ko hi fa'al nahin karta, balke aik doosra, zyada taqatwar difa bhi shuru karta hai jise antibody-mediated ya humoral immunity kehte hain. Is immunity ke asal khiladi B cells hain. Yeh antigens par seedha hamla nahin karte, balke un par tabahi ka nishan laga dete hain. Yeh zehreele (toxic) molecules ko bhi bekaar (inactivate) kar dete hain. Antibody-mediated immunity ke ahem waqiyat yeh hain:

Proliferation: Har B cell apni satah par maujood B receptor proteins ke zariye antigens se jur jata hai. Helper T cells aise antigen se jure B cells ko pehchan kar un se chipak jate hain. Phir helper T cells aise proteins chhorte hain jo B cell ko taqseem hone par uksate hain. Nateeje mein har B cell se bohat bari tadaad mein cells bante hain jinhein plasma cells kehte hain.
Khoon ke plasma ke kul protein ka wazan ke lehaz se taqreeban 20% antibodies hain.

Differentiation aur Secretion: Zyada tar plasma cells taqseem hona chhor kar mazeed B receptor proteins banana shuru kar dete hain. Yeh B receptor proteins cell se bahar chhore (secrete) jate hain aur ab inhein antibodies kehte hain. Plasma cells sirf chand dinon mein bohat bari tadaad mein antibodies chhor dete hain.
Vaccine antibodies banwati hai aur memory cells banane mein madad deti hai. Vaccines maare hue ya kamzor kiye gaye pathogens se banti hain jo jism mein antibodies banwate hain.
blocks.title: Vaccine

blocks.text: Attack: Antibodies antigen ko seedha tabah nahin karti, balke teen tareeqon mein se kisi aik se us par tabahi ka nishan lagati hain:

Malignant melanoma skin ka jaan lewa cancer hai. Aik khaas qism ka WBC, tumour-infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL), aam taur par cancer ki rasoli (tumour) par hamla karta hai, lekin itna taqatwar nahin hota ke rasoli ko qaboo kar sake. Genetic engineers koshish kar rahe hain ke TIL mein aisa gene dalein jis se TIL tumour necrosis factor (TNF) naam ka protein bana sake. Yeh protein rasoli ke cells ko maar deta hai. Jab genetically engineered TIL mareez ke khoon mein wapas dale jayenge to woh rasoli mein ja kar TNF banayenge aur use khatam karenge.
blocks.title: Immune System aur Gene Therapy

items: Complement: Kuch antibodies antigen se jurne ke baad complement system ke proteins ko fa'al karti hain. Yeh proteins antibody se lipte antigen ki membrane mein ghus kar soorakh kar dete hain. Paani antigen cell mein khinch aata hai, aur woh phool kar phat jata hai.
Macrophages: Kuch antibodies jab antigen se jur jati hain to macrophage unhein pehchan kar antigen ko nigal leta aur tor deta hai.

Killer cells: Killer cells natural killer cells jaise hote hain, farq yeh hai ke in mein aise receptors hote hain jo antibody se lipte antigens ko pehchante hain. Jab killer cell ko antibody se lipta antigen milta hai to woh us se jur kar us cell ko maar deta hai.

blocks.text: Suppression: Kai hafton ke baad suppressor T cells antibody response ko band kar dete hain.

Memory: Fa'al B cells ke clone ke kuch cells plasma cells nahin bante aur antibodies nahin banate. Is ke bajaye yeh memory B cells ban kar baqi reh jate hain. Agar wahi antigen dobara aaye to yeh tez secondary response (doosra jawab) dete hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke memory B cells 'plasma cells ke clone' ke un cells se bante hain jo antibodies nahin banate. Yeh sahi nahin: plasma cell aakhri darje ka cell hai jo sirf antibodies banata hai. Antigen se fa'al hone wale B cell ka clone do qism ke cells deta hai: plasma cells (antibodies banane wale) aur memory B cells. Is liye upar 'fa'al B cells ka clone' likha gaya hai.

blocks.alt: Primary response: antigen aik munasib B cell ke B receptor proteins se jurte; helper T cell is se jurta aur afzaish se plasma cells bante jo antibody molecules chhorte, aur aik memory B cell. Usi antigen se dobara saamna: secondary response, jis mein memory B cell bohat zyada plasma cells, kahin zyada antibodies aur naye memory B cells deta.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehli dafa (primary response) thore plasma cells aur antibodies bante hain, magar memory B cell bhi banta hai. Usi antigen se doosri dafa saamna ho (secondary response) to yahi memory B cell foran bohat zyada plasma cells aur antibodies banata hai; isi liye doosra jawab tez aur taqatwar hota hai.
